products.title: Head Extreme Elite - Head
products.description:
HEAD EXTREME ELITE - An intermediate range racket with the latest technology from Head Padel. Get better in the attack zone with it in your hands. Made with a new diamond mold. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

We analyze the HEAD EXTREME ELITE, the little sister of the Extreme series, but the bravest in terms of colors in its design, with a fluorine yellow aesthetic that attracts attention wherever it goes. Same diamond shape, high balance and power as the rest of the Head Extreme rackets, but with variety in its composition.

PLAYER TYPE

Recommended for padel players with an intermediate or advanced level. It is an attacking racket for backhand players who want to attack on each point.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The most important construction data of the HEAD EXTREME ELITE are:

- Carbon fiber on the frame for high durability.

- The planes are made of the best fiberglass that the Head brand has. It gives us the necessary durability and comfort for a high ball output with little effort.

- Power Foam rubber inner core. It does not transmit any vibration to the player during the game.

- AUXETIC technology for the best experience that technology in a racket can give you. It adapts to every moment of the game.

- New Soft Buttcap technology, which is a new white cap on the handle that reduces vibrations. This one is orange.

PLAY STYLE

On the court, this new HEAD EXTREME ELITE is a powerful racket with good control thanks to its absorbent materials, such as fiberglass and power foam rubber. It will give us better solvency in attacking shots than in defense.

products.title: Drop Shot Axion Attack 2.0 2026 - Drop Shot
products.description:
DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2.0 2026 - Jon Sanz's new padel racket for the 2026 season. An offensive racket, in teardrop format. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2.0 2026 is the official padel racket of Jon Sanz, developed together with the Navarrese player for the 2026 season. This padel racket offers everything that a professional padel racket can offer, which is a comfortable feel, versatile game and a Premium design.

PLAYER TYPE

This model is focused on high-level, competitive players looking to have a professional player's racket. Recommended above all to an offensive player rather than a defensive one.

The new DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2.0 2026 offers high power but with good control thanks to its teardrop format and medium-high balance, with the right and necessary sweet spot. Maintains a good level of control in long exchanges.

The Eva Pro High Density core provides a firm and stable feel, ideal for players looking for a solid response on impact and greater security in each shot.

The faces are made of 24K Twill Carbon, a light and reactive material that improves the ball's exit speed and provides a more defined feel when hitting.

Other technologies of this racket is the Ergo Pro Protector system, a protector already incorporated to protect the frame from the typical friction of this sport. In addition, we highlight the anti-vibration system incorporated into the bridge called the Anti Twist System.

Esta VIBORA BLACK MAMBA RADICAL ESMERALD 2027 nos parece una versión especialmente interesante ya que su polivalencia la hace una de las palas Vibora más completas, con un alto control y con una potencia elevada para no dejar una bola sin apretar cuando sea necesario.

TIPO DE JUGADOR

Siendo una de las más híbridas de la marca, la catalogamos como una pala avanzada-profesional, pero especialmente buena si tenemos un nivel de juego medio de competición y queremos mejorar todos nuestros golpes.

La VIBORA BLACK MAMBA RADICAL ESMERALD 2027 mantiene su famoso formato híbrido que ya hemos visto en ediciones anteriores. El balance de este modelo es medio y su punto dulce lo suficientemente amplio para golpear la bola correctamente aunque no le demos concretamente por el centro.  En esta Radical se prescinde de la rugosidad y se apuesta por un acabado brillo liso, que además le da una estética más limpia y elegante.
products.englishTitle: Vibora Black Mamba Radical Esmerald 2027 - Vibor-a
products.englishDescription:
VIBORA BLACK MAMBA RADICAL ESMERALD 2027 - This racket seeks slightly more comfortable sensations without losing the personality of the Black Mamba. The 24K carbon, the EVA PRO Balance rubber and its medium balance achieve a very complete padel racket. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

This VIBORA BLACK MAMBA RADICAL ESMERALD 2027 seems like a particularly interesting version to us since its versatility makes it one of the most complete Vibora rackets, with high control and high power so as not to leave a ball loose when necessary.

PLAYER TYPE

Being one of the most hybrid of the brand, we classify it as an advanced-professional racket, but especially good if we have an average competition level of play and want to improve all our shots.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The VIBORA BLACK MAMBA RADICAL ESMERALD 2027 maintains its famous hybrid format that we have already seen in previous editions. The balance of this model is medium and its sweet spot is wide enough to hit the ball correctly even if we do not hit it specifically in the center. It has been manufactured with 24K carbon faces and a medium hardness EVA PRO Balance core.  The result is a solid but pleasant shot, with good ball output and stability.

 In this Radical, roughness is dispensed with and a smooth gloss finish is opted for, which also gives it a cleaner and more elegant aesthetic.

products.title: Wilson Optix V2 Lite Lila 2026 - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON OPTIX V2 LITE LILAC - Do you want extra lightness? The new Optix Lite offers you a lower weight. Round in shape, it guarantees high control. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The WILSON OPTIX V2 LITE LILAC 2026 is the most economical Wilson racket in the 2026 collection. It is a LITE version, lighter and more manageable for a player who is starting out and looking for greater security and comfort. It is a padel racket with a round format and an extensive sweet spot.

PLAYER TYPE

This type of racket is recommended for an intermediate player who plays occasionally and is looking for a light racket with total maneuverability. The Balance of this racket is low and it will help us above all to move it from the bottom. Allows you to react faster.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

This WILSON OPTIX V2 LITE LILAC 2026 is a racket manufactured with a weight of 355 grams and low balance. In turn, it has a 100% fiberglass composition, both the frame and the planes incorporate this material. It offers greater flexibility than carbon, increasing ball output but reducing hardness.

The core is made of Foam, a low-density foam, with a soft touch, to improve control and ball output as soon as the ball comes into contact with the racket.
